cost.question: How are design and shopping costs calculated?
cost.answer: Get your photo and preferences ready before signing in. You can also try the homepage example without an account. Sign in to start the analysis. Creating or refining a design depends on your credits and the features available to your account. Products are priced separately from design credits. Check the seller’s price, stock and shipping.

studioExample.previewBody: Homa shows the changes in a photo of your home and finds pieces for the look you like.
studioExample.briefBody: Make the cabin brighter and cosier while keeping the bed and timber walls.

shopping.similar: Similar to the rug in the design
shopping.exclusions: Curtains and delivery are excluded. Check current price and stock with the seller.

studioExample.title: Explore the result in Studio.
studioExample.intro: Compare the original photo and the new design, then select a marker to see why each change was suggested.
studioExample.keepBody: Keep the bed and timber walls to retain the character of the cabin.
studioExample.changeBody: Orange curtains tinted the daylight and the floor had one continuous finish. Pale curtains and a textured rug change both.

curtain.name: Curtains
curtain.title: Pale, light-filtering curtains
curtain.reason: A lighter fabric softens daylight and lets the natural colour of the timber show.
curtain.placement: Use around the room, with curtains that tie back on either side.

rug.name: Rug
rug.title: A textured rug beside the bed
rug.reason: A pale rug defines the sleeping area and adds a softer surface underfoot.
rug.placement: Extend it from under the bed into the walkway beside it.

shoppingList.title: Shopping list for this design
shoppingList.intro: Suggested pieces for the cabin makeover

items.rug: Light rug with a natural texture
items.bedding: Light bedding, sheets and olive cushions
items.mirror: Full-length mirror with a wooden frame
items.accessories: Baskets, tray, candles and decorative accessories

bedroom.label: Bedroom
bedroom.title: The same bed. A whole new feeling.
bedroom.body: Explore bedding, rugs and lighting in your room. Try your design in Homa, then choose the pieces to bring it together.

living.label: Living room
living.title: Start with the sofa you already love.
living.body: You do not need to replace everything. See rugs, colours and accessories in your space before choosing what to buy.

cabin.label: For hosts
cabin.title: A place your guests will want to stay.
cabin.body: Give your guest space a fresh feeling, from layout ideas to choosing the pieces that complete the room.

buyingJourney.title: From wanting a change to designing and shopping with Homa

thought.label: A wish for change
thought.title: Ready for a change.
thought.body: You look around your home and imagine a different feeling. You are not yet sure what to change, or what to keep.
thought.alt: A woman sits on her existing sofa, thinking about changing her living room
thought.caption: It starts here. Your home, and the things already in it.
thought.ribbon: You want a change at home. But you do not know where to begin.

search.label: Too many choices
search.title: So many choices.
search.body: Everything looks good in the showroom. But next to your sofa, rug and lighting? It is hard to choose without seeing the whole picture.
search.question: What if I buy it and it does not work in my room?
search.alt: A black-and-white photograph of a woman seen from behind in a furniture showroom
search.caption: It is about how your choices work together.
search.ribbon: Hours of searching. Still unsure what works in your home.

assistant.label: Meet Homa
assistant.title: This is where
assistant.body: Homa reviews your room and finds layout solutions for your furniture, taste and budget.
assistant.alt: The same woman photographs the original living room with her phone
assistant.analysis: A look at this living room
assistant.dimensions: You also provide the room measurements and constraints.
assistant.ribbon: Imagine having an interior designer by your side.

notes.layout: The coffee table sits close to the walkway. A more open layout could make it easier to move through the room.
notes.keep: The dining table already fits beside the kitchen. Keeping it leaves more of the budget for the seating area.
notes.direction: Daylight comes in at the balcony. Lighter curtains could carry it further into the room.

result.label: From design to shopping
result.title: See it in your room.
result.body: Explore the design and refine it through conversation. Homa searches for pieces that suit your plan, helping you move from an idea to a choice.
result.alt: The supplied final living room design with a light sectional sofa, coffee table and warm lighting
result.plan: Check current prices and availability with the seller. Compare materials, dimensions and terms against your budget.
result.ribbon: Know what to buy and where to find it.

design.layoutChange: Two compact tables together leave room to pass beside the sofa.
design.label: Designed with Homa
design.ribbon: Now see the design in your home.
design.body: Explore ideas for your space. Change the colours, furniture and layout and see the result on your room photo.
design.alt: The same living room redesigned with a light sectional and pendant light
design.compare: Compare the living room before and after

footer.tagline: The distance between dream and reality is just one click. We help you experience a more confident, beautiful, and tasteful result in your space.
